$comment: Ground items (docs/adr/0071-ground-items.md): small physical things lying on the ground that the player picks up (E, or X on a controller, with the crosshair on one). They are not saved terrain: they are scattered over each chunk as it loads, deterministically from the world seed and the cell, by `rules` (the first rule whose conditions hold and whose roll hits places its kind; one item a cell at most); the ones picked up are kept gone with the world. `kinds`: the item each gives (an item of shared/inventory/inventory.json, the same as a drop's, so they stack together); its look is that item's `look` (one look per item, the same in the hand, on the hotbar and loose), a small mesh baked into the chunk's mesh, turned at random about up and scaled within `scale`. A rule's conditions: `on` (the full block under the cell), `under` (one of `blocks` within `withinRows` rows above: the canopy), `nearWall` (a column `reach` cells away in a compass direction solid for `rows` rows up from the cell: a cliff's foot); `density` is the share of the cells that pass that get one. Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/ground/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-world/src/ground.gen.rs is stale.
